content.text: io-pay is third-party (owned by IO Payments Ltd), and the logs show it returning 503s starting exactly at the onset, with no deployment/change in the window and cpu_limit_cores flat at 3.0 throughout. This is a clear upstream dependency failure.

hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's error rate and latency spiked at 07:33 because its third-party payment dependency io-pay (api.io-pay.example) began returning 503 errors on card lookups; no deploy/config change occurred in io-shop and capacity (cpu_limit_cores) was flat, ruling out internal causes.
